# Ganexity

Ganexity is a Spanish-first AI phone receptionist and structured lead-capture system for local businesses in Spain, especially Valencia.

Main website: https://ganexity.com/

Main use cases: busy phone lines, missed calls, after-hours call capture, structured phone lead summaries, human follow-up.

Important: Ganexity is focused on reliable call intake and lead summaries, not autonomous price confirmation or risky calendar automation.
